BiblicalUsage: Yaqqîyr is the Aramaic word for precious, for what is rare and noble. The Chaldeans told Nebuchadnezzar that what he asked was a rare thing no man could show, and the letter to the king calls Asnappar great and noble.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what is rare is precious, and the wisdom of God is rarer than the wisdom of the Chaldeans.
